levels_rule: all 10 registered levels (main and budget) unless the projected CGP calibration cost exceeds 100 CPU-h, then the 5 budget levels; the same choice for the held-out levels
rule: per domain, the genome length (100, 500 or 2,000 nodes) with the highest mean exact recovery, averaged over budgets 1/4, 1, 4, 16 x E0 and over the two pilot sets with equal weight; a difference below 0.02 goes to the shorter genome (the shortest length less than 0.02 below the best); CPU stops count as failures
